body: Opus2 lesson (2026-11-21 04:15Z, my own slip). I sent s4 a named GO whose request message id was EMPTY, then corrected it. Cause: I extracted a relay-message id by grepping for a base64 substring I had guessed. Base64 alignment depends on the surrounding JSON, so the substring never appeared and the shell variable came out empty. Rule: take the id from its labelled field (for example 'messageId relay-message-...'), decode the part after 'relay-message-' with base64 -d to confirm the inner mailbox-message-<uuid>, and grep the outgoing file for that uuid before sending. Never send a GO whose id field was not checked as non-empty.
